## Professional Summary

Fahim Hossain is a skilled Shopify Developer and Front-End Developer with extensive experience in building high-converting eCommerce stores and modern web applications. Specializing in custom Shopify solutions, Liquid customization, and performance optimization, Fahim helps businesses launch and scale their online stores with cutting-edge technologies.

## Core Competencies

### Shopify Development (Primary Focus)
- Custom Shopify theme development from scratch
- Liquid template customization and optimization
- Shopify schema configuration for dynamic sections
- Shopify Markets setup and internationalization
- App integrations and custom functionality
- Performance optimization for faster load times
- Checkout customization and conversion optimization

### Front-End Development
- **React.js**: Component-based architecture, hooks, context API
- **Next.js**: Server-side rendering, static generation, API routes
- **TypeScript**: Type-safe development for scalable applications
- **JavaScript**: ES6+, async/await, modern JavaScript patterns
- **CSS Frameworks**: Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Material UI
- **Animation Libraries**: Framer Motion, GSAP, Swiper.js
- **State Management**: Redux, Context API
- **HTTP Clients**: Axios, Fetch API

### Back-End Development
- **Node.js**: Server-side JavaScript runtime
- **Express.js**: Web application framework
- **MongoDB**: NoSQL database design and querying
- **Firebase**: Authentication, real-time database, hosting

### CMS & Website Builders
- **Shopify**: Advanced Liquid development, theme architecture
- **Webflow**: Visual development, CMS integration, interactions

### Tools & Technologies
- **Version Control**: Git, GitHub, GitLab
- **Technical SEO**: On-page optimization, schema markup, Core Web Vitals
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager
- **Tracking Pixels**: Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Pinterest Pixel
- **Design Tools**: Photoshop, Figma (for development handoff)
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Netlify, Shopify CDN
